a.lede: The developers of Goddess of Victory: NIKKE have confirmed that hackers tampered with the game's PC launcher scripts in a supply-chain attack, distributing malware capable of stealing credentials and cryptocurrency wallet data. [...]
a.title: NIKKE PC game launcher hacked to spread remote access, data-stealing malware

b.lede: Attackers have compromised the update infrastructure for the cPGuard web security suite to distribute a backdoor and a data-stealing script. [...]
b.title: Hackers hijack cPGuard autoupdate to deploy backdoor, steal data
